subject: We could not leave your family parcel
preview: Choose a new delivery time today before your parcel is returned.
lesson: Unexpected delivery urgency is a reason to pause.
Check purchases in the shop or carrier site you normally use.
Do not pay a surprise redelivery fee from a message link.
preheader: Your parcel is being held after an unsuccessful delivery attempt.
bodyParagraphs: Our driver was unable to complete delivery at your address. Your parcel will be held until the end of today.
Choose another delivery window to avoid having the parcel returned to the sender.
footerLines: Need help? Contact Puddlejump Parcel Support.

subject: A household payment did not go through
preview: Review the payment before evening to prevent a hold.
lesson: A failed-payment warning can create false urgency.
Check activity through the known app or number on your statement.
Never share financial details after following an unexpected link.
preheader: Action is needed to prevent an interruption to your scheduled payment.
bodyParagraphs: We could not process your latest household payment. No further attempts will be made automatically.
Review the payment before 6:00 PM to prevent a temporary hold on outgoing payments.

subject: Your family benefits need an update
preview: Confirm the household update by Friday to avoid a delay.
lesson: A deadline about important benefits is designed to feel pressing.
Contact the program through paperwork or a number you already trust.
Do not provide private family information through a surprise message.
preheader: Your response is needed by Friday to keep this update on schedule.
bodyParagraphs: We are missing a required household update for your benefits record.
Confirm the update by Friday so your next benefit period is not delayed.

subject: A larger refund may be waiting for your household
preview: Check the refund notice before the review window closes.
lesson: Unexpected money and a short deadline are both warning signs.
Use a known tax professional or official site to verify a notice.
Do not provide tax or identity information from an email link.
preheader: Your refund review window closes soon.
bodyParagraphs: A recent review indicates that your household may qualify for a larger refund.
Check the notice before the review window closes. Unclaimed amounts may be returned for processing.

subject: New activity detected on your family account
preview: Review the new device now before access is restricted.
lesson: Security alerts can use fear to rush a decision.
Open the service yourself and review its security page.
Never give a caller remote access or share a security code.
preheader: New device activity requires your attention.
bodyParagraphs: We detected access to your family account from a device we do not recognize.
Review the activity now. Access may be limited if we cannot confirm it was expected.

subject: You missed a message about your child
preview: An urgent voicemail about your child is waiting.
lesson: A vague message about family can provoke a quick reaction.
Call the known person or organization directly to check.
Avoid unfamiliar links claiming to play a voicemail.
preheader: A new urgent message about your child is waiting.
bodyParagraphs: You have one unheard voicemail marked urgent. The caller said it concerns your child.
The message will remain available until 8:00 PM today.

subject: A family prescription is waiting for pickup
preview: Confirm pickup today before the prescription is returned.
lesson: Health-related deadlines deserve a calm, careful check.
Call the pharmacy using a number you already have.
Do not disclose health or payment information through a message link.
preheader: Your prescription will be returned if pickup is not confirmed today.
bodyParagraphs: A family prescription is ready, but the pickup window ends today.
Confirm that you still plan to collect it before the order is returned to stock.

subject: Past-due notice for your household service
preview: Review the balance now to prevent an evening shutoff.
lesson: A shutoff threat uses fear and urgency to demand action.
Check your paper bill or the utility site you normally use.
Do not send money through a payment method named in a surprise message.
preheader: Payment is required today to prevent an interruption.
bodyParagraphs: Our records show an overdue balance on your household service.
Service is scheduled for interruption this evening unless the balance is reviewed today.

subject: The family garden meetup moved this afternoon
preview: See the new location before your family leaves home.
lesson: A last-minute plan change is a reason to pause.
Confirm the location with an organizer you know.
Do not share family plans after following an unexpected link.
bodyParagraphs: Due to a last-minute site issue, this afternoon’s family garden meetup has moved.
Check the updated location before leaving home. The start time has not changed.

subject: Your child's reserved story expires today
preview: Keep the reservation before it is released tonight.
lesson: A small deadline can still be used to rush you.
Check reservations through the library or shop you normally use.
Ask whether you expected the message before opening its link.
preheader: Your child’s reserved story will be released tonight.
bodyParagraphs: The story reserved for your child has reached the end of its hold period.
Keep the reservation before it is released to the next reader tonight.
